basics.name: Zhiyu Wang | 王智语
basics.summary: I'm an ML Research Scientist working on autonomous AI scientists, time-series modelling, and AI for biology and healthcare.

work.name: Sapient Intelligence
highlights: Developing Praxit, an autonomous AI-scientist framework with DAG-based execution lineage for solution provenance; achieved roughly 30% higher performance at 10% of the cost of Claude Code with Opus on Karpathy's AutoResearch prompt.
Showcased Praxit at AI4 2026 through live booth demonstrations and conversations with prospective customers and collaborators.
Generating synthetic time-series data and developing HRM-based forecasting models for weight-management applications.

work.name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
work.summary: Protein substructure alignment via optimal transport. Supervisors: Prof. Pietro Lio & Prof. Liang Hong.
highlights: Developed PLASMA, a module based on optimal transport for fast and highly accurate identification of locally similar protein substructures. Accepted at ICLR 2026. (Paper)
Demonstrated consistent +10-30% ROC-AUC improvement across 7 backbone protein language models on 3 VenusX tasks.

work.name: University of Cambridge
work.summary: Hierarchical protein representation learning, multi-omics integration with GNNs (Supervisor: Prof. Pietro Lio), and graph-based facial expression analysis (Supervisor: Prof. Hatice Gunes).
highlights: Developed TCPNet, an SE(3)-equivariant topological neural network for hierarchical protein representation learning. (Paper) (Invited Talk)
Awarded Highly Commended M.Phil Project Prize 2024-2025.
Multi-omics integration using heterogeneous graph networks for single-cell data. (Paper)

work.name: Xunfei Healthcare Technology
work.summary: Built a knowledge distillation pipeline using a teacher LLM to synthesize medical instruction examples, improving student model (Xiaoyi) instruction-following accuracy from 34% to 82% via supervised fine-tuning.

work.name: Luojin Data Information
work.summary: Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline with MongoDB vector store and LangChain agents for automated financial report classification, achieving 92% query translation accuracy and 97% entity matching rate through semantic search.

work.name: National Health Service (NHS)
work.summary: Created an automated chatbot generation service for hospitals, reducing development time from weeks to 30 minutes.
highlights: Delivered a live demonstration at Great Ormond Street Hospital to clinicians, and presented at UCL to IBM, Microsoft, and Intel, earning media recognition from an IBM Master Inventor.

work.name: University College London
work.summary: Organized biweekly group discussions for 12 first-year computer science students, offering academic guidance and peer support.

references.name: Professor John McNamara
references.title: IBM Master Inventor, UCL Honorary Professor
references.relationship: Supervisor of Zhiyu's Year 2 project (NHS Chatbot) in UCL
references.reference: I've had the pleasure of working with many early professionals in the academic consulting space, but Zhiyu is exceptional; a galvanising force for good who relishes a challenge. Before I worked with he directly, I was aware of his excellent reputation through the university – someone that everyone knows, and feels that they can approach for help, advice and guidance. Zhiyu is one of those people in an organisation that will help galvanise a project with enthusiasm, humour and talent – which is infections across the team and the organisation. Its been a joy to work with him, both in terms of being a technologist and a professional. I look forward very much to the opportunity to work with Zhiyu again.
